summary: The order-update connection's ck refuses the session: the desktop sends no order subscription and does not connect again with the refused token; the web sends none either and publishes nothing.

notes: RB-12: the web subscribes order updates only on ck with s=Ok (definedge_order_adapter.py:98-105); a refused ck is logged and nothing is sent. The desktop reports the refusal (AuthFailed) and waits for a new login (websocket::manager).
